meta.name: improve-architecture
meta.description: Audit an area of the codebase and propose the smallest structural moves that improve it - untangle boundaries, kill duplication, fix seams, break cycles. Produces a prioritized plan and decision records, not a rewrite. Use when a codebase feels tangled, hard to change, or is becoming a ball of mud, or when asked to improve or refactor architecture.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码结构并给出最小改动计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码库变得混乱、难以修改，需要系统性地改善结构。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code structure and propose minimal improvement moves
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase feels tangled and hard to change, and you need systematic structural improvements.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审查代码库的某个区域，找出结构问题（如模块耦合、重复逻辑、循环依赖），然后提出最小的改进步骤，并生成优先级排序的计划和决策记录，但不会直接修改代码。
howto.when: 当代码库感觉混乱、难以修改，或用户要求改进架构、重构时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查一下支付模块的架构，找出最需要改进的地方。
say.note: Claude 会分析该模块的结构问题并给出改进计划。

say.text: 这个项目的代码越来越难改了，帮我诊断一下架构问题。
say.note: Claude 会整体审查并列出优先级排序的改进项。

howto.what_en: Claude audits a codebase area, finds structural issues (e.g., god modules, leaky boundaries, duplication, cycles), and proposes the smallest moves to fix them, producing a prioritized plan and decision records without rewriting code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the codebase feels tangled or hard to change, or when asked to improve or refactor architecture.

say_en.text: Audit the payment module's architecture and suggest the most impactful improvements.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the module and gives a prioritized plan.

say_en.text: This project is getting hard to maintain. Diagnose the architectural issues.
say_en.note: Claude reviews the whole codebase and lists top improvements.
